title: DarGlobal projects across the GCC
content: DarGlobal's public villa project listing names Dubai projects including D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates, Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai, DG1, Da Vinci Tower with interiors by Pagani, Urban Oasis by Missoni, W Residences and The Pagani Penthouse. In Ras Al Khaimah it lists The Astera with interiors by Aston Martin and Top of the Astera. In Qatar it lists Les Vagues by Elie Saab and Trump International Simaisma. In Saudi Arabia it lists Trump Park Residences and Trump Mansions in Rayana, Wadi Safar, plus Rayana Mansions, D'Mansions, Amaya Luxury Plots, Trump Executive Residences, Neptune with interiors by Mouawad, and Trump Tower Jeddah. This is a source snapshot, not a live inventory feed.

title: DarGlobal projects in Spain
content: DarGlobal's public projects listing includes Tierra Viva, described as design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini, and Painite Villas, also described as design inspired by Automobili Lamborghini, in Benahavís, Spain. It also lists Marea with interiors by Missoni in Cortesin, Spain. Consult the linked DarGlobal page for current project information.

title: DarGlobal projects in Oman
content: DarGlobal's public projects listing includes AIDA in Oman, Fairway Villas, Azure Oceanfront Villas with interiors by Fendi Casa, Amour Sans Detour, The Great Escape, The Great Escape 2, Coastal Investment Villas, Sunrise Haven, Marriott Residences, Trump Cliff Villas, Trump Golf Villas and Trump International Hotel, Oman. Project names and locations are reproduced from the public listing; availability and terms should be checked at the source.

title: DarGlobal company overview
content: DarGlobal describes itself as an international luxury real estate investment and development platform. Its public website describes architecturally distinctive residential and mixed-use assets in global locations, including branded luxury apartments, masterplanned communities and hospitality-led destinations. The company page references projects across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain and beyond, with partnerships spanning automotive, fashion and hospitality brands.

title: DarGlobal global project portfolio
content: DarGlobal's public projects portfolio lists projects in Dubai and Ras Al Khaimah in the UAE; Benahavís and Cortesin in Spain; Doha and Simaisma in Qatar; Muscat and AIDA in Oman; London in the United Kingdom; Riyadh and Jeddah in Saudi Arabia; and Noonu Atoll in the Maldives. The portfolio includes residential, hospitality and mixed-use developments.

title: Wasalt platform overview and services
content: Wasalt describes itself as a Saudi-based real estate platform connecting buyers, renters, developers and brokers across the Kingdom. The public site offers property listings, verified projects, masterplans, online auctions and daily rentals. Its homepage lists REGA license number 1200016591, Ministry of Tourism license number 73106008, and commercial registration number 7017195509. The site says creating a property listing involves an account and property details.

title: Wasalt residential properties for sale in Riyadh
content: Wasalt's Riyadh sale page categorizes available property types as apartments, villas, residential land, commercial buildings and investment plots. The page includes residential districts such as Al-Arid, Al-Narjis, Al-Rimal, Al-Yasmeen, Al-Malqa and Al-Munisiyah. Individual availability, prices and listing counts change; use the source page for current inventory.

title: Wasalt residential project listings in Saudi Arabia
content: Wasalt's public project-filtered residential sale search identifies Shams Al Riyadh as a featured project and displays a price range from SAR 2.40 million to SAR 135.05 million in the indexed public result. Prices and availability are dynamic and may have changed; verify on the Wasalt page.

title: Wasalt Riyadh listings examples
content: Examples visible in Wasalt's public Riyadh sale page include a villa in Al-Arid, North Riyadh described as 322 square metres and priced at SAR 2,700,000, and a three-bedroom floor in Ohod, South Riyadh priced at SAR 480,000. These are examples from the page snapshot and may no longer be available. Verify prices and details directly at Wasalt.
